categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three primary business segments: Smart Livelihood (智慧民生), Urban Comprehensive Management (城市综合管理), and Smart Parks (智慧园区). Additionally, the company provides Computing Equipment Integration Services (算力设备集成服务) and Operation & Maintenance Services. These segments deliver comprehensive solutions including pre-consultation, scheme design, equipment procurement, software development, system integration, and operational maintenance across smart city applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including AIoT (Artificial Intelligence & Internet of Things), GIS (Geographic Information System), BIM (Building Information Modeling), cloud computing, big data analytics, and artificial intelligence. Development methods include intelligent sensor node and terminal development, IoT platforms, GIS-based data visualization and analysis, video surveillance image recognition, intelligent human-machine interaction, and indoor high-precision positioning services. The company holds CMMI Level 5 certification, the highest international software capability maturity model certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies, public institutions, state-owned enterprises, and large private enterprises. Key industries served include education, healthcare, tourism, buildings, communities, municipal management, public safety, and industrial parks. The company serves customers across smart livelihood, urban management, and smart park sectors, with particular strength in government and institutional clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major presence in South China (83.92% of 2023 revenue), particularly in Guangdong and Guangxi regions. Additional operations extend to North China (5.17%), East China (2.62%), Southwest China (7.95%), and Northwest China (0.33%). The company maintains branch offices in Beijing, Hunan, Shantou, Shenzhen, Hainan, Zhongshan, Zhuhai, Kunming, Chongqing, Xinjiang, and Huai'an.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a systems integrator and comprehensive solution provider in the midstream to downstream segments of the smart city technology supply chain. It sources hardware and software components from upstream suppliers (including major vendors like Huawei, Inspur, and H3C), integrates these with proprietary software and services, and delivers complete solutions directly to end-user customers including government agencies and enterprises.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI and IoT technologies, developing information-secure (信创) compatible solutions for government systems, expanding smart city applications across multiple sectors, and building computing infrastructure integration capabilities. R&D focuses on AI-driven anomaly detection, multi-scenario operation and maintenance platforms, 5G healthcare management systems, document collaboration tools, grid-based inspection management, and zero-carbon smart park solutions. The company emphasizes indigenous innovation and information security in alignment with national digital transformation initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through two primary models: (1) Smart City Solutions - providing comprehensive system integration services including consulting, design, procurement, software development, and implementation, with revenue recognized upon customer acceptance and system handover; (2) Operation & Maintenance Services - providing ongoing technical support and maintenance services with revenue recognized over the service period. Revenue is recognized at a point in time for solutions and over time for maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading comprehensive smart city solution provider with significant competitive advantages. It holds national-level specialized and innovative enterprise status (国家级专精特新"小巨人"企业) and has been recognized as a top 100 enterprise in China's intelligent building industry for 15 consecutive years. Key competitive strengths include extensive project experience, comprehensive resource integration capabilities, superior project quality, and strong customer relationships with government and institutional clients.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized technology services enterprise with 2023 revenue of 770.6 million yuan, representing 3.26% growth from 2022 (746.3 million yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 42.2 million yuan in 2023, down 33.08% from 2022 (63.1 million yuan), primarily due to increased asset impairment provisions. Total assets reached 2.17 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 18.56% from 2022. The company employs 478 people with 35.15% in R&D roles.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through comprehensive end-to-end smart city solutions combining consulting, design, implementation, and maintenance services. Key value propositions include: (1) Deep industry expertise across multiple smart city verticals; (2) Advanced proprietary technologies in AIoT, GIS visualization, and AI-driven analytics; (3) Strong project execution capabilities with quality certifications and awards; (4) Information-secure (信创) compatible solutions meeting government requirements; (5) Integrated approach breaking down data silos and enabling cross-system coordination; (6) Proven track record with government and institutional clients across diverse applications.
